headline: Malaysia chose exemption. Singapore subsidises. Thailand built an email lane.
context: Malaysia exempted firms under RM1m from e-invoicing from January 2026, then under RM3m from 1 September 2026. India cut its threshold, Singapore pays grants and Thailand offers an email lane.

changes.summary: Correction: Singapore's S$5,000 grant goes to larger businesses, not early adopters, and Malaysia's e-invoice exemption, RM1m when this was published, rose to RM3m on 1 September 2026; the ringgit conversions and Indonesia figures are removed.

cards.big: Malaysia keeps small firms out of mandatory e-invoicing by exemption: under RM1m from January 2026, under RM3m since September. Three peers took other routes.
cards.sub: Singapore pays SMEs a S$1,000 grant to join. India cut its bar to INR 5 crore in 2023. Thailand lets small firms email their e-tax invoices.

cards.big: India moved the other way: in August 2023 it cut its e-invoice threshold from INR 10 crore to INR 5 crore of turnover. Malaysia has raised its bar twice since December 2025.
cards.sub: Malaysia's exemption rose from RM500,000 to RM1m in January 2026, then to RM3m on 1 September 2026, LHDN said.

cards.big: Singapore is phasing in GST InvoiceNow from November 2025 to April 2031, with a S$1,000 transition grant for SMEs and free solution packages until March 2031.
cards.sub: Larger firms get S$5,000. Malaysia's MSME Digital Grant offers a 50% match up to RM5,000.

cards.big: Thailand lets firms with income up to THB 30m issue e-tax invoices as time-stamped PDFs by email. Any firm can use the XML route with a digital signature.
cards.sub: Malaysia's lighter lane is temporary: until end-2027, firms with turnover up to RM5m can submit consolidated monthly e-invoices, LHDN's FAQ says.

cards.big: The choice was never just 'mandate or exempt.' Three peers built middle paths Malaysia did not adopt.
Exemption is the cheapest political answer. Capacity-building is the expensive structural one. The peer models cost more, and produce more lasting compliance.
